title: Physician Client Accounts: One Account per Location
content:
**Clause.** Under Physician Client Accounts, an organization holds one client account per location, up to the number of accounts of the same class that its account class permits for one organization (the class's client accounts per organization); a location never has two accounts.

## The clause in parts

| Element | What the clause fixes |
|---|---|
| Unit of the account | One client account covers one location of the ordering organization (a practice location, health center, hospital outreach program or employer site). |
| Several locations | An organization with several locations holds a separate account for each of them, all in the same account class. |
| How many | The number of accounts of the same class one organization holds is capped at its class's client accounts per organization figure. |
| One location | A location is never covered by two accounts, whatever the organization's count. |

## Cases (hypothetical organizations; the cap of 5 is an example input)

- An organization in a class that permits 5 accounts per organization holds 4 accounts, one for each of its locations, and opens a practice at a fifth location: a fifth account, for that new location, is within the cap.
- The same organization, now holding 5 accounts of the class, adds a sixth location: a sixth account of the class would exceed the cap.
- An organization holding 2 accounts asks for a second account for a location that already has one: no second account is opened for that location, since a location never has two accounts, even though the count is well under the cap.
